Premise (thread, read on main `269fb670`, file `build-seat1/36113/premise-read.md` in the project folder): holds. Fig. 42's "object name inside the view row" (#35878 section 1 item 1) is overturned, not re-arranged, and the maintainer decided that with the conflict written on the drawing (fig. 45 note 9, 「按照这个效果图」), so no new question. The rest of #35878 stays. The PR body lists the nine merged changes the premise names in section 3.
Basis: card #36113; epic #36107; fig. 45.
Scope, the seat's reading of the premise's forks:
- F1, where export lives. Export is in the view-settings popover today (#29175), not in More, and the card says not to change view settings. So the new 「导入 / 导出」 button carries import and every export format, and the view-settings popover keeps its export footer unchanged. Two doors for export is the literal reading of both card lines and flips nothing that merged. If the maintainer wants a single door, removing the footer is a small follow-up.
- F2: ⋮ More stays at the far right of the view row. F3: author-declared list actions stay in the view row, between 「导入 / 导出」 and New, in today's relative order. F4: New reads 「新建」 plus the object's singular label; the phone floating button is unchanged. F5: with only import or only export the button names that one; with neither it is not drawn.
- F6: until #36112 turns the page-actions group on, the object row's right end is empty. Nothing is added for the interim.
- Narrow widths: the view row's own width (ResizeObserver) decides, not the viewport: first 「导入 / 导出」 folds into More, then the search keyword text hides. Phone is unchanged.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: runs in parallel with #36112 (which only adds a slot at the far left of this header). Overlap with #36123 and #36133 (#35955), #36129 (#35892, `ListView.tsx`), #36128 (#36015 PR2), and #36047 slice 2. `overlap-check.mjs` before each push. Declaration L2 at `TIER_DEFAULT` on the green head; L1 at L1-b. The PR carries `Fixes #36113`.
